title: Arizer Screen Pack for Extreme, V-Tower and XQ2
description:
The Arizer Screen Pack is a must-have accessory for anyone with an Arizer Extreme Q or V-Tower vaporizer. These Arizer Extreme Q Screens are designed to fit perfectly in your vaporizer and ensure your device functions at its best. The Arizer Extreme Q Screen Pack includes 2 dome screens and 2 flat screens. The screens are made from high-quality materials designed to last, so you won’t have to worry about them wearing out quickly. Using a wrong or dirty screen negatively affects vapor taste, so replace them regularly with the Arizer Extreme Q, V-Tower and XQ2 Replacement Screens.

Offering Arizer and OEM dome screens

We recommend the Arizer for durability and more guaranteed fit. The OEM do fit well and are good for the discounted pricing.
